hook.name: PadFeeHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for graduated pons v2 memecoin pools. Collects and distributes protocol, creator, launchpad, and charity fees from the quote leg and optional burn from the memecoin leg in each swap. Supports a decaying snipe tax on buys, optional coin-flip game integration on buys, and conditional swap access controls (relayer allowlist, wallet balance gates, fixed-digit amount enforcement).
